focal_point: A prepared meal, large and appetizing. A price sits in a corner and is readable.
eye_path: Food first, price second, small menu items third.
grid: Hero food plus a side rail of dishes.
scale_ratios: The meal is the hero. Prices are the largest type and there are several.
type_choices: Sans numerals, a script mark, several sizes.
photo_art_direction: Commercial food, tight, warm light. Appetite works.
offer_placement: One lead price, then more dishes. The second and third prices cost the grade.
trust_and_cta: A code or URL more than a phone. Retail, not a call.

glance_3s.reason: Glance gets dinner and a price.

emulate: One hero dish and one price. Move the rest of the menu off the front.
anti_patterns: A second and third price on the rail.
summary: Mailbox meal kit. Photography is excellent. One price would make it an A-.
